items.name: Win-back / re-engagement email
items.one_line: Email that re-activates lapsed customers or cold subscribers before they are suppressed.
items.value_evidence: Klaviyo lists winback among the core flows to build first

sources.title: Klaviyo Help: Getting started with flows (updated 2026-03-30)
sources.supports: recommends building welcome series, abandoned cart, post-purchase and winback flows first; separate email and SMS welcome flows

items.name: Worldbuilding / series bible
items.one_line: A reference document defining a story world (rules, history, places, factions, tone) so many writers stay consistent.
items.value_evidence: Produced inside writers' rooms, game studios and IP-development deals; rarely a standalone purchase.
items.note: Logline, tone, world rules, character arcs, season or book arcs, glossary, change log.

items.name: X (Twitter) post
items.one_line: Single short post on X that lands one idea, take or update in a few lines.
items.value_evidence: Fiverr's social media copywriting Platform facet lists Twitter at only 47 gigs on 2026-10-04, the smallest of the major platforms.

sources.title: Fiverr: Social Media Copywriting category (Platform facet read 2026-10-04)
sources.supports: Fiverr's Platform filter with live gig counts, a SUPPLY signal: Instagram 1910, Facebook 1663, LinkedIn 1338, TikTok 1009, Pinterest 376, Threads 238, Snapchat 123, Reddit 96, Twitter 47, Discord 5, Quora 3

items.note: Limits live in plat:x_post. X ghostwriting for founders exists as a niche service; see genre:x_thread.

items.name: X (Twitter) thread
items.one_line: Numbered series of linked posts that unpacks one idea, story or lesson, with a hook post that earns the click into the thread.
items.value_evidence: Twitter is the smallest major platform on Fiverr's social copywriting facet (47 gigs on 2026-10-04); thread ghostwriting survives as a founder niche.

sources.title: Fiverr: Social Media Copywriting category (Platform facet read 2026-10-04)
sources.supports: Fiverr's Platform filter with live gig counts, a SUPPLY signal: Instagram 1910, Facebook 1663, LinkedIn 1338, TikTok 1009, Pinterest 376, Threads 238, Snapchat 123, Reddit 96, Twitter 47, Discord 5, Quora 3

items.note: Each post should stand alone when quoted; the same outline ports to a LinkedIn carousel or Threads.

items.name: YouTube video chapters (timestamps)
items.one_line: Timestamped chapter list in a video description that splits a long video into named, skimmable sections.
items.value_evidence: Small add-on to video or podcast work; Fiverr podcast gigs offer segment timestamps (135 gigs on 2026-10-04).

sources.title: YouTube Help: Video chapters
sources.supports: Manual chapters come from description timestamps: first timestamp must be 00:00, at least three timestamps in ascending order, minimum chapter length 10 seconds

sources.title: Fiverr: Podcast Writing category (Service includes facet read 2026-10-04)
sources.supports: Fiverr podcast-writing gigs list deliverables: Episode summary 143, Segment timestamps 135, Relevant links 125, Script writing 114, Show notes 91, Discussion guide 80, Ad break 59 (gig counts, supply signal)

items.note: YouTube's rules: first timestamp 00:00, at least three timestamps in ascending order, each chapter at least 10 seconds (YouTube Help).

items.name: YouTube channel post (Community / Posts tab)
items.one_line: Text, poll, quiz or image post on a YouTube channel's Posts tab that keeps subscribers engaged between uploads.
items.value_evidence: Written by the channel team as part of channel management; no separate marketplace category found on 2026-10-04.

sources.title: YouTube Help: Create a post
sources.supports: YouTube's own help page for channel posts (text, image, poll, quiz, video), formerly the Community tab

items.note: Polls double as audience research for the next video's title and topic.

items.name: YouTube title + description (video metadata)
items.one_line: The title, description, hashtags and pinned comment that sell a video in search and suggested feeds and route viewers onward.
items.value_evidence: YouTube's own help pages set description-based features (chapters from description timestamps); metadata writing is bundled into YouTube SEO and channel-management gigs.

sources.title: YouTube Help: Video chapters
sources.supports: Manual chapters come from description timestamps: first timestamp must be 00:00, at least three timestamps in ascending order, minimum chapter length 10 seconds

items.note: Title and thumbnail text are written as a pair and must not repeat each other. Limits live in plat: cards.

items.name: YouTube long-form video script
items.one_line: Full spoken script (with visual and B-roll cues) for a YouTube video of several minutes, built to hold retention from hook to end screen.
items.value_evidence: Upwork's script writer job type names 'YouTube video scripts' first among projects, with a typical $30-$56/hr band, above the blog ($15-$35/hr) and content-writer ($15-$40/hr) bands on the same page (Upwork, 2026-01-21).

sources.title: Upwork: 14 Types of Freelance Writing Jobs and What They Pay (published 2026-01-21)
sources.supports: Upwork's own list of freelance writing job types with typical hourly rate bands charged on Upwork (blog/web content $15-$35/hr, content writer $15-$40/hr, ghostwriter $20-$45/hr, script writer $30-$56/hr, email & newsletter $15-$40/hr; newswriters $34-$62/hr citing Glassdoor) and project lists per type

sources.title: Fiverr: Scriptwriting category
sources.supports: Scriptwriting is a Fiverr subcategory; Hindi is among the top seller languages on the facet (867 gigs on 2026-10-04)
